RESULT [attribution]: Matches the performance of attribution methods that need thousands of trained models using only a handful. Demonstrated on ImageNet classifiers, CLIP, BERT and mT5. But the MAGIC comparison above measures TRAK's LDS at only 0.07-0.24 on CIFAR-10 under 1-5% data removal.
US [attribution]: TRAK is the standard efficient tool (it is in dattri and the trak library), and it can reuse per-epoch checkpoints the trainer already saves. Given its weak ground-truth correlation for removing subsets, treat it as a way to find candidate harmful images inside a batch the seeded gate has already flagged, not as the gate itself.
CORRECTION [attribution]: TRAK's own claims are confirmed: it matches methods that need thousands of models using a handful, on ImageNet, CLIP, BERT and mT5 (ICML 2023).
